name: Auth Encrypt
description: Client-side AES-256 encryption of password (and login username) fields on Drupal's login, register, and user-edit forms, decrypted server-side via OpenSSL. Zero configuration; no admin route or permission.
project_description: Auth Encrypt encrypts authentication credentials in the browser before they leave the form and decrypts them on the server. It attaches to the core login, registration, and user-edit forms, encrypting the password fields (and the username on login) with CryptoJS AES-256-CBC using a per-form, per-session key that Drupal generates server-side and embeds in the form as a hidden field. On submit, a validation callback re-derives the key, decrypts the fields with OpenSSL, and passes plaintext to core's normal authentication. Key mismatches and decryption failures are logged. The module is zero-configuration (no settings form, no permission, no dependencies) and loads CryptoJS from a CDN or from a local /libraries/crypto-js copy.
